extractedText: Salon Branding Guide: 9 Strategies That Increase Retention and Revenue Author: DesignerPeople Blog June 19, 2026 A few years ago, running a successful salon was often about having skilled professionals, a good location, and loyal word-of-mouth customers. While those factors still matter, today’s beauty industry operates very differently. Modern clients discover salons through Instagram, Google reviews, websites, reels, influencer recommendations, and online searches long before they ever book an appointment. In many cases, they have already formed an opinion about your business before speaking to your team. Fortunately, 96% of consumers are open to writing reviews for your business that other people can refer to when booking their appointments! That’s why branding has become one of the most important growth tools for salons. A strong brand actually helps people remember you, trust you, recommend you, and most importantly, come back. At DesignerPeople, we have observed one simple truth while working with service businesses: clients rarely remember every service detail, but they always remember how a brand made them feel. Let’s explore how salon branding can help you create that lasting impression and build a business that grows through loyalty instead of discounts. Many salon owners believe branding is only for luxury chains or celebrity-owned businesses. The reality is much simpler if your customers have choices, branding matters. a) Luxury Salons: Selling an Experience, Not Just a Service Luxury salons aren’t just offering the usual haircuts, facials, or grooming treatments. They are selling absolute exclusivity, comfort, personalisation, and premium experiences. Clients walking into a luxury salon always expect every detail to feel thoughtfully designed. Right from the reception area and consultation process to staff communication and after-service follow-ups. This effectively creates a stronger perception of value and makes premium pricing feel justified rather than expensive. When people choose luxury salons, they’re often buying confidence as much as the service itself. Most customers can find dozens of alternatives within a short distance. This is where branding becomes a powerful differentiator. A clear brand identity helps customers remember your salon long after their appointment is over. Whether you are known for hair transformations, colouring expertise, styling trends, or personalised consultations, branding helps create a unique space in customers’ minds. When clients immediately think of your salon for a specific expertise, you’ve already won half the battle.
